author: elpatrick845
quote: GTA VI is an absolute disappointment. Rockstar has completely lost sight of what made GTA legendary. Instead of delivering the immersive gameplay, freedom, creativity, dark humor, and unforgettable experience that defined the franchise, the game seems obsessed with sexualized content, unnecessary sexual agendas, and cheap shock value. It feels like Rockstar has sacrificed the identity of GTA in favor of pushing provocative content. This is not what made GTA great, and it is certainly not what fans have been waiting for. The result is a deeply disappointing experience that fails to deliver on almost every level. Rockstar needs to stop chasing controversy and start focusing on making an actual GTA game.
